reference_frame: board coordinate frame: x=0-100mm (length), y=0-40mm (width), z=0 at PCB top surface
notes: fixed reference point, identical for all 5 variants; independent of MLCC position, which differs by variant (see pcb_coordinates.csv)

pointing: toward PCB, i.e. -z direction (straight down at the board)
notes: primary acoustic measurement; same position and fixture for every run and every board variant, deliberately independent of MLCC position so board-to-board comparisons are not confounded by a moving microphone

pointing: perpendicular to PCB top surface, small angle tolerance per instrument
fixture: optional - only when an LDV validation session is run
notes: not required for baseline; target spot recorded per session in the run log, typically the MLCC location or board center for mode-shape spot checks
